title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in after multiple password reset attempts. They report that the account remains inaccessible.

title: Payment Failure - Transaction Declined
description: Customer's card is being declined despite sufficient balance. They tried multiple times without success.

title: Website Loading Slowly
description: Customer reports that the website takes too long to load, especially on mobile devices.

title: Unable to Reset Password
description: Customer is not receiving the password reset email despite requesting it several times.

title: Order Confirmation Missing
description: Customer completed a purchase but has not received an order confirmation email.

title: Product Image Not Displaying
description: Several product images are missing from the product details page.

title: Shipping Address Update
description: Customer needs to update the shipping address for an order that has not yet been dispatched.

title: Refund Request - Order Cancelled
description: Customer cancelled an order and wants an update regarding the refund processing time.

title: Unable to Create New Account
description: Customer receives an error message while submitting the registration form.

title: Discount Code Not Working
description: Customer cannot apply a promotional discount code during checkout.

title: Duplicate Payment Charged
description: Customer reports being charged twice for a single order and requests an investigation.

title: Mobile App Crashing
description: The mobile application crashes when the customer opens the checkout screen.

title: Incorrect Order Status
description: The order tracking page shows an incorrect status even though the package has shipped.

title: Email Notifications Not Received
description: Customer is not receiving account notifications or important order updates by email.

title: Account Access - Two-Factor Authentication
description: Customer cannot complete two-factor authentication because the verification code is not arriving.
